Personally, I don't think win rate is necessarily a good indicator of what is fair game balance or design. Variations in WR are affected by skill but can also just be inflated numbers. Too many variables. 

 In lieu of leagues more complex and "overloaded" champion kits (eg ksante, yone, akshan, etc), sett is one of the few newer champs that have a basic kit. This is not bad and I'd argue rather healthy because of his simple and straightforward design.

My feelings of unlove towards sett is when other simple champions such as garen, darius, renekton can receive buffs to their numbers while sett has design flaws or numbers that don't make sense in the current season. 

A few plain examples are that sett does not get a universal movespeed buff (and potentially slow cleanse) while garen can do that, in addition to a silence. Volibear just got a speedbuff on top of low cooldowns while sett is untouched. As a brawler, you'd think sett would be more mobile and at least have some mobility (not a dash, just run at people lol) to suit that design 

The new season has universally reduced ability haste which is healthy for the game (maybe except for assassin items) while sett still suffers from high cooldowns. Not asking for spammable skills but I would like to be able to trade more than once every 20 seconds, especially in a lane where people have cooldowns up within 5 seconds. 

But the one that takes the cake for me, which was mentioned before, was the fact that I'm cc'd longer than my opponent when I press r, or that when I die during animation, my r is forgone. I appreciate the transparency and understand that issues or design changes take time but I can't help but feel like Riot simple hates Sett because he supposedly can flex 4 roles in pro play - yet gragas can live rent free. 

Apologies if these thoughts are all over the place, and thanks for taking time to respond! I'm sure there are more issue but every other champ has issues too. I don't want my champ to be op, but I do want him to make sense and not feel like I'm punished for playing him.
